## `neuro.uint8Array.findLastIndex`

Instance method on `Uint8Array.prototype`.

> Returns the index of the last element in the array where predicate is true, and -1
> otherwise.

## Signatures

```ts
findLastIndex(input: { uint8Array: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: number; index: number; array: Uint8Array) => unknown; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint8Array.prototype.findLastIndex` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
